content: Aluminum hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide are antacids that work together to alleviate symptoms such as heartburn, acid indigestion, and stomach upset. These medications are also used to manage conditions like peptic ulcers, gastritis, esophagitis, hiatal hernia, or excessive stomach acid (gastric hyperacidity). They function by neutralizing stomach acid. These antacids are available over the counter, but they may also be prescribed for other purposes. Consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information. This medication is available in two forms: chewable tablets and liquid. After taking the tablets, drink a full glass of water. The liquid can be taken alone or mixed with water or milk. Always follow the instructions provided on the package or prescription label. If you have any questions, ask your doctor or pharmacist for clarification. Take this medication exactly as directed. Do not take more or less than prescribed, and do not use it more frequently than instructed. Unless directed by your doctor, do not use antacids for longer than 1 to 2 weeks. Before starting this medication, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to aluminum hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide, or any other drugs. Provide a complete list of all prescription and nonprescription medications you are currently taking, especially if you are using aspirin, cinoxacin, ciprofloxacin, digoxin, diazepam, enoxacin, ferrous sulfate (iron), fluconazole, indomethacin, isoniazid, itraconazole, ketoconazole, levofloxacin, lomefloxacin, nalidixic acid, norfloxacin, ofloxacin, sparfloxacin, tetracycline, or vitamins. Additionally, inform your doctor if you have a history of kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, let your doctor know. If you become pregnant while taking this medication, contact your doctor immediately. If you are using this medication to treat an ulcer, adhere strictly to the dietary recommendations provided by your doctor. If you miss a scheduled dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to compensate for a missed one. Side effects from aluminum hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide are uncommon. To minimize the chalky taste, take the medication with water or milk. Notify your doctor if you experience any of the following symptoms, especially if they are severe or persistent: Diarrhea Constipation Loss of appetite Unusual tiredness Muscle weakness Store this medication in its original container, tightly sealed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Dispose of any expired or unused medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on safe disposal. Do not share this medication with anyone else. This medication is sold under various brand names, including Alamag®, Aludrox®, Di-Gel®, Maalox®, Magnalox®, Mylanta®, and Rulox®.
